text: fix(config): ci.yml pull_request paths-ignore (.backlogit, docs, .autoharness, *.md) means docs/backlog-only PRs never run the CI workflow, so the 'Detect code changes' job (the paths-filter detector) never reports. CURRENT CONTEXT (2026-07-10): operator set ruleset PR-Required required_status_checks=[], so this no longer BLOCKS merges today (backlog/docs PRs merge CLEAN). LATENT: if required checks are re-added, docs/backlog PRs would again leave the required check pending. Fix if/when required checks return: remove paths-ignore from the pull_request trigger so 'changes' always runs; the 'Build, vet, lint & test' job already self-gates via if needs.changes.outputs.code==true + the dorny/paths-filter denylist, so it stays skipped for backlog-only diffs. Low priority while required_checks=[].

Production runtime browser executable-path option for Edge-only / non-PATH hosts. The deployed bot's ChromeRunner.run (internal/browser/runner.go) and NewLiveMeeting (internal/browser/meeting.go) build the chromedp allocator via browser.AllocatorOptions(...) with NO exec-path option, so on an Edge-only host (or any host where a Chrome/Chromium binary is not on PATH) the bot aborts with 'exec: google-chrome: executable file not found in %PATH%' -- the same failure the U7 test-harness fix (task 010.007-T) addresses ONLY for the integration harness. Add an optional ExecPath (e.g. a browser.Options.ExecPath field + config/env plumbing) so production launches on Edge-only/non-PATH hosts without a manual PATH prepend. SPLIT OUT of feature 010-F per Scope Boundary Auditor (2026-09-05): out of 010-F 'selector/path hardening + verification' scope -- this is runtime deployment portability, a distinct feature. Refs: docs/plans/2026-09-05-teams-live-selector-path-hardening-plan.md (U7 scope-boundary note); runner.go, meeting.go.
